title: Route map journey
summary: A stylised map story: the camera eases from leg to leg while a marker draws the route between labelled stops, stop cards land on arrival and distance and duration counters run to their stated totals, ending on the whole route.
needs: Stop names with latitude and longitude in decimal degrees
Optionally the total distance and duration, as stated facts
techniques: Natural Earth 1:50m land and borders (public domain)
dot-matrix land from an offscreen mask
gallery_share: Animated travel and route maps (road trips, flight paths, delivery and expedition routes) are a staple of travel reels and explainer videos.
limits: Coastlines are 1:50m and simplified: fine for countries and regions, not city streets (the camera never zooms below about 2 degrees of span)
Legs are arcs or rhumb lines, not real roads, rails or flight paths
No city or country names besides the stops; borders are Natural Earth de facto lines
Coordinates must be supplied; the recipe has no gazetteer
